reviews.title: Has gotten less annoying as a free user
Almost useless with current problems
reviews.text: I've been using this app since 2013, but over the last five years or so, it has gradually become useless. During the night, it loses access to the microphone, and during that time, you can't tell if you were sleeping or what is happening there's some sort of problem-solving if you go to the app in the App Store, but it's completely inadequate. I'm not using my phone for anything in the middle of the night, so there's no reason for it to be losing function. I'm obviously going to have to find a new sleep app that works. Because this one does not. It also used to show me my snoring, but now it won't show me my snoring because they made that a premium feature.  I think when apps take things that initially came with the app and then make them cost extra that is poor behavior on the part of the manufacturer. It's bait and switch at the very least. If you have an iPhone, there's no point in using this app.

reviews.title: Sleep better

reviews.title: Sleep enhancement life goal
reviews.text: I’ve been using the sleep app for many years and I’ve enjoyed many of its features and admire how it continues to improve. I can now not only track my sleep habits, but it also tracks when I dream, talk in my sleep, have faithfulness and even snore. I never knew that I snored. So I’ll be tracking this and using it as long as it continues to improve. That means that I mean, if it as long as it continues to keep up with technology and outrun AI and also improve my health.

reviews.title: Can't even try it without having to start a subscription
reviews.text: I have no interest in the premium version of this app immediately and have no interest in adding a subscription to a family group. Unfortunately that means I can't get past the questionnaire. Just a bunch of files talking up space on my phone otherwise.

reviews.title: Great app, just one thing…
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for probably over a decade and it has become a fixture in my wake up routine (despite hitting the snooze 100 times before I actually wake up. Now, why the missing star, you may ask? Well, I used to wake up to a song of my choice, but then it suddenly stopped one day and I figured the app just glitched, which had happened before. I go to redo the settings, only to find out that using a song is now a “premium” feature. Now, I can certainly live without waking up to music, but it was the principle of the whole thing and I was disappointed that the app fell victim to this whole ‘suddenly placing free features behind a paywall’ thing. Guys, please be better than that. Aside from that, great app and I will continue to use it, provided that you don’t suddenly paywall anything else.

reviews.title: One App to Rule Them All!!!
reviews.text:
These 3 points will make this app perfect and allow the Apple Watch to beat Fitbit in ALL areas. I'm speaking to developers. 

1) Apple Watch Integration
• Allow for Apple Watch heart rate monitor and accelerometer and microphone if worn into bed. It can also assist with waking with the tapping in the wrist. 

2) You guys have another app- Power Nap- that would be amazing to integrate    
•Integrate it as a power nap mode. I take naps all the time. I am always calculating the time so I won't go into deep sleep.   

3) Allow for both accelerometer and microphone to collect data. 
• The accelerometer works better with the intelligent snooze but the microphone records more accurate data. Integrate the two for the ultimate experience. 

4) allow editing to sleep data. When I lay in bed both before sleep and after waking it often records it as light sleep and sleep time is inaccurate which also effects sleep quality number.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text:
This app used to be great back when it was free, when it based tracking off movement before  audio. 
But it started declining a while after it became paid. First, a one time payment. Then, subscription.  

It’s all about collecting data and marketing in-app purchases now.  And the tracking has no relation to real life experience at all.  
With multiple smartwatch options, sleep cycle is now obsolete.

I appreciate its statistical feedback in the morning and am aware of how much sleep my body usually needs to feel good. I’m very grateful for Sleep Cycle. I never would have guessed I’d still be using it all these years later, but here I am, a loyal user.

reviews.title: Best app for sleeping
reviews.text:
I really enjoy this app. A lot. It has kept me motivated to start early to go wind down and to set it up (the rain background noise is noiiiice!) and I love the sleep tags to check down the line what maybe helped that day and if there might be a pattern. 
What I’d love to see is a quickstart option, for people like me who fall asleep dangerously fast (a new behavior for me). 

I like keeping tabs on what helped or hindered sleep, but I’d like to see the tags pop up after you wake up too. Very often I wake up at night, might have headaches, might wake up with cloudy brain etc. 

What has been tough to get it work is the blood pressure thingy. It is a hit or miss. More miss than hit. Bit annoying.

reviews.title: Used to love it
reviews.text: I have used sleep cycle for literally years. Always loved it until earlier this year when I noticed that every morning when I wake up, my phone screen is completely dark. Imagine waking up in the dark, wanting to use your phone to make sure you don’t trip over a dog, but nothing except the black abyss on your phone screen. I cannot find a way to disable this and it makes me want to find a different app. Is there somewhere to turn this off? Is it a bug? It’s annoying is what it is. Every morning I have to carefully navigate across the bedroom to the bathroom, close the door, turn on an annoying bright light to be able to fix my phone screen, all of which defeats the purpose of gently waking up and using the subtle glow of my phone screen to navigate across said room while avoiding dogs.

reviews.title: CANNOT QUITE DECIDE
reviews.text: It’s a very interesting app, thought I haven’t yet decided if it’s worth trying the paid version.  I tried it originally to see what it might say about my snoring; I have diagnosed sleep apnea and sometimes use my c-pap machine, sometimes not.  I have no way to verify whether I snore more or less on any given night but I do find on occasion, when I’m restless for one reason or another, it says I fall asleep much, much faster than I do making me doubt the accuracy of its various sleep stats.  I haven’t had time to research it but it makes me wonder how it can glean all those stats predominately by my breathing, moving, snoring sounds, etc.  And, I wonder, how could it distinguish between two different people?

reviews.title: To the CEO of Sleep Cycle
reviews.text: Your app has caused me to lose faith in humanity and I hate you. I know that sounds extreme but it’s the truth. I used to love your app. I used it all the time to track my sleep and enjoyed checking it every morning. That was many years ago and at some point I uninstalled your app and forgot about it. Flash forward to last month. I have been very stressed and anxious about money since losing my job and it’s been effecting my sleep. I’m waking up with bad headaches and just exhausted. So I decided to download your app again. I thought it was the same app as before and at first it appeared so: I could check my sleep score every morning and listen to any sounds and I even preferred your gradual alarm to the apple alarm. I felt like I was at least getting to understand what was happening in my sleep. Then it happened. A charge for $57.99 for your app that resulted in an overdraft and fee on my bank account. I DID NOT SUBSCRIBE TO YOUR PREMIUM YEARLY SUBSCRIPTION. I did not authorize this!!!!!! I cannot afford that!!! I filed for a refund because obviously I didn’t consent to that charge and the refund was denied. I appealed it and it was denied again. For no good reason. I don’t understand. I have contacted Apple and they say it’s the “policy”. You tricked me and really messed up my finances. I am already going through such a hard time in my life and that $57.99 would make a difference in my life. It was actually more like $90 after the overdraft fee. And I can just picture you on your yacht drinking martinis while I can’t afford groceries for the week because of your greed. The world is truly going in a bad direction and you are proof of that. So I just wanted you to know that I hate you and I hope you have the life you deserve.

reviews.title: Love but I have a few gripes
reviews.text: I have been using this app for over 10 years, started in 2015. I do love the alarm feature and being able to see my quality of sleep when I wake up. But my main complaint that I have with this app is that you end sleep through swiping up. The amount of times where I have accidentally ended a recording early, because I would wake up for a second and try to go to my home page is ridiculous. If there was another way to end a sleep session or even a way to combine nights I would love that. It’s so upsetting that even though I should’ve been back asleep right now, I’m instead writing this review. Especially since my session is over and I know that recording is now wasted. I still have to use the alarm to ensure I’m up in time for work and all that data will be deleted. Also the SleepGPT feature sucks and was a wasted update.

reviews.title: Insomniac Tracker
reviews.text:
Because I have never been a good sleeper, I like knowing just how many or how few hours I slept in the night and how much I snored or talked. 
I do not like the little pop-up faces asking me how I feel or slept whatever I wish those were gone.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Usually it’s pretty accurate to my Apple Watch that’s doing the same thing may be off by a few percent sometimes but for my phone not to be on my wrist and being that accurate all in all a good app.

reviews.title: Uninstalling this.
reviews.text:
The alarm now consistently goes off hours after I’ve set it. So it is now useless to me. Too many new features have clearly bloated the app and now the whole reason it exists doesn’t work. I work night shifts and already have a terrible sleep schedule as a result and this is unacceptable to me. I missed a family event because this ALARM APP’S ALARM DIDN’T WORK. Don’t bother with this one. It’s primary feature doesn’t function as advertised.

P.S. your other “feature” is also broken. I would know because as an insomniac I have personally experienced many sleepless nights while your “sleep algorithm” was recording my breathing. At the end of each of those nights, I would end the recording, only for my app to claim that I slept multiple hours when I was wide awake for every cursed second and watched the sun rise without getting a single wink of sleep. So if you’re considering getting this so you can find out what your sleep cycle is then don’t bother.

reviews.title: Long time user
reviews.text: I have been using this app for 8 plus years. I love the sleep stories and ambient noises. One complaint I have is that the ambient noise used to be able to be set for all night. Now it is a max of 90 minutes. The lack of it can wake me up I also wish the ambient noise could be set to play right after the sleep story ends so I don’t have to set it. I also feel the app isn’t as reliable as it used to be.

reviews.title: Alarm resets everyday
reviews.text: Please change the alarm setting back to being set always.  For instance when I set the alarm to 6:30, it used to stay on 6:30 every time I opened the app.  Now, It resets to 6:00 everyday.  Since most people get up at the same time every day, why does it reset back to default??

reviews.title: Strange nights…
reviews.text: One time it tracked my sleep as full light sleep but the thing was at the very bottom. The graph line chart, THE VERY.BOTTOM. And it was like that the whole night. No twists and turns. Just that. And then one time I got 0 sleep quality but I was perfectly fine! Also, I would prefer it if you don’t remove the sound “tropical rain” Please.. it’s my favorite sound.. and it not aggressive rain, it’s just peaceful against leaves sound.

reviews.title: Sound maxes out randomly
reviews.text: I’ve used the app for years and had even bought it back before it was free, but now when I try to listen to a podcast or something while falling asleep, the sound randomly becomes SUPER LOUD, which is incredibly frustrating and counter productive. This doesn’t happen anytime except when I’m using sleep cycle. It’s jarring and stressful, and it has made it harder to fall asleep. When I go to “fix” the volume after an incident like this, the phone acts like the volume was already low and sometimes lowering it further disables it entirely. I don’t know what’s happening, but it’s very troubling, as I’d like to keep using the app.

reviews.title: Questionable  Accuracy
reviews.text: I’ve used Sleep Cycle for 7 or 8 years. A lot of additional features have been added.  I noticed over a year or so it records me as being awake usually between 1.5 to 2.5.  Also there are times I know I’m awake but find it shows I’m sleeping, many times deep sleeping.  The position of my phone hasn’t changed.  So based on my many years using Sleep Cycle it becoming grossly inaccurate in recording time asleep.  There no way for me to determine if the level of sleep is accurate.  That’s why I didn’t renew the Premium version. I am now using Sleep Cycle as an alarm clock and no longer let Apple iHeath connect to it.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Complete scam job. Don’t bother. I don’t know who they’re linked to or who they buy your info from, but stay clear. I’ve never used the app, it wasn’t on my phone but I somehow caught a $69.99 charge to my bank account. reviews.title: Disappointing - Sane Bug After Years
reviews.text:
I used Sleep Cycle in the past and stopped using it because it had a serious alarm problem. I decided to download it again recently, assuming these bugs had finally been fixed.

Unfortunately, the exact same issue happened again.

I set my alarm for 7:30 AM, with the Smart Alarm window set to 7:00–7:30 AM, and selected my preferred alarm music. Around 4:00 AM, the app unexpectedly woke me up with a beeping sound instead. That is roughly three hours before my scheduled alarm and completely outside the Smart Alarm window.

When I checked the app afterward, the alarm was still showing 7:30 AM / 7:00–7:30 AM, but the sound was no longer what I had selected.

This is a sleep alarm app. If I can’t trust it to keep the time and alarm settings I selected, I can’t trust it to wake me up.

I came back because I thought these issues had been fixed. Unfortunately, I’m disappointed to find that I’m experiencing essentially the same problem I had years ago. I should not have to use a second alarm because I don’t know whether Sleep Cycle will actually follow the settings I chose.

Please fix the alarm reliability and stop changing/overriding user-selected alarm behavior.

reviews.title: Not accurate at all for me
reviews.text:
I Don’t snore very much so with the microphone it thinks that I’m not asleep. I can be reading a book listening to a podcast going in the kitchen to get toast and I think I’m asleep so this is just not very accurate. It needs to take a clue from some other parts of the phone. I slept at most five hours last night and it says I slept for 10 hours. I’ll try the motion tonight but when I first fall asleep in the recliner, it’s sitting on a table, so it’s not going to record anything until I get into bed but at least if I’m awake and I go in the kitchen we know that I’m not asleep. I also use the Apple Watch, which is not so accurate & Elemind which overestimates so it’s somewhere in there. I’m waiting for  DUSQ & Bia  Sleep to maybe get an accurate estimate.

It’s almost impossible to find the setting where you can choose between accelerometer and microphone. It thinks I’m talking when I listen to an audiobook to go to sleep It doesn’t want me to do that, but I don’t want to use their sleep aids and I need something to listen to, but the settings are very hard to find i’d like to try the accelerometer. It says the settings are in profile, but they’re not there. The only selection for the microphone is to choose how long you want to keep the recordings It’s very hard to figure out how to use this app. There’s no information in the profile except for some sleep information from the past nothing I can change. The guide tells you how to what you should use, but it doesn’t tell you where to find it. As usual AI is no help with that.

I got help from ChatGPT outside of the app and that was better so the selection is under alarm, which is confusing that’s where you choose whether you want the microphone or the accelerometer to wake up .Anyway, it’s good at listening with the microphone and I have other trackers going at the same time so it’s OK. But I probably won’t renew the subscription for that reason.

I’ve been using this app for yeeears. It used to be great. Recently, and yes it’s updated, it claims I take 2 hours to fall asleep, almost every night. Also, my heartbeat is no longer recorded at all (I have an Apple Watch), and no sound gets recorded anymore- I’ve even spoken if I wake up in the middle of the night. It also doesn’t register me waking up and PICKING UP MY PHONE! I don’t know why you guys have made things worse over the years. My phone is new. So in summary, here’s what you need to fix:
Heart rate monitoring, recalibrate sleep tracking, fix lack of recording, obviously if you pick up and use your phone (and remember it), you’re awake, so fix that. Super disappointing and I might have to cancel. The only thing it seems to be good for anymore is slowly waking you.
